meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总指定时间内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要整理多场会议纪要并形成周报
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes from a date range into structured reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into weekly reports

howto.what: 当用户要求整理会议纪要时，Claude 会查询指定时间范围内的会议列表，获取每场会议的纪要文档和逐字稿链接，然后生成一份结构化报告（单日概览或多日周报），并可应要求将报告写入飞书文档。
howto.when: 当用户说出“帮我整理这周的会议纪要”、“总结最近的会议”、“生成会议周报”等类似请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: Claude 会查询本周一到现在的会议并生成周报。
Claude 会查询今天的会议并生成单日概览。

say.text: 生成上个月的会议周报
say.note: Claude 会按月拆分查询并汇总报告。

howto.what_en: When the user asks to organize meeting minutes, Claude queries meetings within a specified time range, retrieves note documents and verbatim links for each meeting, generates a structured report (daily overview or multi-day weekly report), and can optionally write the report to a Lark document.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says requests like 'help me organize this week's meeting minutes', 'summarize recent meetings', or 'generate a meeting weekly report'.

say_en.text: Help me organize this week's meeting minutes
say_en.note: Claude will query meetings from Monday to now and generate a weekly report.
Claude will query today's meetings and generate a daily overview.

say_en.text: Generate last month's meeting weekly report
say_en.note: Claude will split queries by month and aggregate the report.
